unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.message: This form has changes that have not been saved. Leaving now discards them.

title: Products
subtitle: Browse and manage your products
exportNeedsProducts: Nothing to export: this list is empty.
categoryModuleWarning: Choosing "{{category}}" files this record under the {{module}} module — it stops being counted as a product.

carriedOver.both: Location and category are carried over from the previous product
carriedOver.storage: The location is carried over from the previous product
carriedOver.category: The category is carried over from the previous product

confirmPurgeMsg: This action cannot be undone. The product will be permanently removed from the database.
noArchivedItemsDesc: Products you delete will appear here. You can restore or permanently remove them.
categoriesUnavailable: The categories could not be loaded, so this form may be missing some of its fields.

empty.title: No products
empty.addFirst: Add your first product to a location. Export unlocks once there is a product.
empty.definedWithoutStock: Products that exist only as a definition — for example ones created inside a recipe or a BOM — are listed here once they have stock. Add one to a location to see it.

hidden.title: Some products are hidden
hidden.description: Products that belong to a module stay out of this list while "Module data in general lists" is off. Turn it on in Settings to see everything in one list.
hidden.inlineCount_one: {{count}} product is hidden — turn on Module data in Settings to see it.
hidden.inlineCount_other: {{count}} products are hidden — turn on Module data in Settings to see them.

actions.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this product?

import.pleaseWait: Please wait while we process your products.
import.title: Import products
import.unsupportedRequiredFields: {{categories}} rows cannot be imported from a file: a cell cannot hold {{fields}}.
import.addedToExisting_one: {{count}} record added to a product you already had. It is listed as its own row under the same name.
import.addedToExisting_other: {{count}} records added to products you already had. Each is listed as its own row under the same name.

labelMatch.label: Rows with a label code
labelMatch.hint: The Label Code column of an exported sheet says which product a row is about.

notes.add: Every row becomes a new product; the label code is ignored.
notes.skip: A row whose label code names a product here is left alone. A row with no code, or an unknown one, is added.
notes.overwrite: A row whose label code names a product here writes its columns onto it. Quantity is never overwritten — stock moves through a receipt or a count.

labelMatch.needsColumn: Map the Label Code column first, otherwise there is nothing to match on and every row is added.
labelMatch.noCodesInFile: The Label Code column is mapped, but not a single row carries a code — codes appear once a label has been printed. In this mode every row will be added as a new record, exactly as in the add mode.

quantityHints.pcs: Number of pieces of this product

form.templateUnitHint: {{product}} is counted in {{unit}} — this record takes that unit unless you choose another.

weightPerPieceHint: Enter weight or volume of one piece; total is auto-calculated.

messages.addToShoppingListFailed: Failed to add to the shopping list
messages.unitLookupFailed: Could not check which unit this product is kept in. Try saving again.
messages.quantityClearedOnUnitChange: Quantity cleared — the new unit measures something else.
messages.fieldsHiddenByCategory: This category hides the {{fields}} field(s) — what you typed will not be saved.
messages.categoryFilterCleared: The category filter was switched off — nothing on this shelf is in it any more
messages.deleteGoesToArchive: The product goes to the archive with the reason you give here, and can be brought back with everything — quantity, location and price. Only permanent deletion, in the archive, cannot be undone.
messages.confirmBulkDeleteBody: The products go to the archive and can be restored.
messages.confirmBulkDeleteBody_one: The product goes to the archive and can be restored.
messages.confirmBulkDeleteBody_other: The products go to the archive and can be restored.

validation.storageUnavailable: This location is no longer on the list — choose one of the available locations
validation.categoryUnavailable: This category is no longer on the list — choose one of the available categories

bulkEdit.title: Bulk Edit ({{count}})
bulkEdit.subtitle: Select fields you want to change for all selected products.
bulkEdit.warningText: Changes will be applied to all {{count}} selected products. Fields you didn't select above will remain unchanged for each product.
bulkEdit.warningText_one: Changes will be applied to the {{count}} selected product. Fields you didn't select above will remain unchanged for that product.
bulkEdit.warningText_other: Changes will be applied to all {{count}} selected products. Fields you didn't select above will remain unchanged for each product.
bulkEdit.errorNoFields: Select at least one field to change

fields.generateCodeHint: An internal code of this organization, from the range GS1 reserves for in-house codes, so it cannot be mistaken for a manufacturer's code. It is valid only inside the organization: goods sold on through other businesses' tills need a GTIN from GS1.
fields.purchasePriceUnitHint: Per 1 {{unit}} — not the amount paid for the whole quantity.

minStockHelp: Set a threshold to see this product in the 'Running low' list.

consumeDialog.title: Remove from stock
consumeDialog.description: How many of "{{name}}" would you like to remove? ({{quantity}} {{uom}} available)
consumeDialog.aboveAvailable: There is only {{max}} on the shelf.

itemNotFoundDescription: The product you're looking for has been removed or never existed.

stock.noUnitRecorded: No unit of measure recorded for this product

valuation.currentRate: Average cost of layers on hand
valuation.noRate: No cost layers yet — receive stock with a price to build one.
valuation.rateDescription: Stock value is FIFO; this is the average of the cost layers still on hand.
valuation.title: Valuation

detail.virtualStorageHint: Used up to zero, the system moved this record here — it no longer counts toward stock. "Move" brings it back to a shelf, then "Add" restores the quantity.
detail.notFound: This product no longer exists, or you have no access to it.
detail.inArchive: This product is in the archive.
detail.inArchiveDesc: Deleting a product is reversible — quantity, location and price come back when it is restored. Permanent deletion is the only irreversible one.

threshold.title: Minimum stock alert
threshold.fieldLabel: Alert when the quantity drops to or below:
threshold.scopeNote: The alert belongs to the product: it is measured against everything you have of it, not against this one record.

quickActions.recordLeftList: The record left the products list.
quickActions.equipmentNote: Equipment category: this record is checked in and disposed of rather than consumed and deleted.

noArchivedItemsDescRestoreOnly: Products you delete will appear here, and you can put them back. Removing one for good is switched off for this organization.
noArchivedItemsDescViewOnly: Products you delete will appear here. Putting one back needs a permission this account does not have.
archivedNoMatches: No archived product matches that name.
archivedNoMatchesDesc: Check the spelling or clear the search to see the whole archive.

totals.label: Totals
totals.moduleSlice: Module data is not in this sum — the statistics total counts it.
totals.unlistedLayers: Cost the ledger holds for products with no position here is not in this sum — the statistics total counts it.
totals.unpriced_one: {{count}} position has no cost history and is left out of the value.
totals.unpriced_other: {{count}} positions have no cost history and are left out of the value.
totals.valueUnavailableUnderFilter: The cost layers hold no value for a filtered slice — clear the filters to see the stock value.

unitChoice.title: Enter {{product}} in another unit?
unitChoice.message: {{product}} is kept in {{template_unit}}. A quantity entered in {{chosen_unit}} is converted into {{template_unit}} when saved, and the choice is recorded in the product history.

removalStrategy.label: Which stock leaves first
removalStrategy.fifoHelp: FIFO: what came in first leaves first.
removalStrategy.fefoHelp: FEFO: what expires first leaves first, whenever it came in.
removalStrategy.sharedProduct: This product comes from the shared catalogue, so the order its stock leaves in is the catalogue's and cannot be changed here.
